FL-105.label: An Ableton-like rack: the shipped layout is only version one of the default opinion, and people can easily roll and add their own plugins and visualizers to the views from the ground up.
FL-105.walk: Add a self-authored plugin to the rack; it appears among the modules and works.
FL-105.observed: Wrote a plugin by the contributor skill's bundle format (verification/m3lv/plugin-agent-count.json: it queries the visualization feed and counts agents and waiting ones), pasted its JSON into Library › paste plugin JSON › Import plugin; it joined the Stage as its own module and read 40 agents · 28 waiting, matching the feed (40 / 28).

FL-110.label: Global or current on every module; current modules switch together with the work.
FL-110.walk: Set two modules to current and select a different project; both switch together while a global one stays.
FL-110.observed: Work layer, Sheet: Conversation, Memory Palace and Context Bars read the selected thread ('/REMEMBER IN THE M3LV WALK, THE VIOLIN MAKER…'); picking 'M3LV run 2.ojyz2: use the move tool…' in Threads switched all three together, while Spend, Palace State and Memory Ingest stayed GLOBAL.

FL-111.label: One standard module template that can be dragged and grown or shrunk as much as you want, with a dialogue box for its internal settings, on a very large canvas you can pan and zoom while modules stay the same size.
FL-111.walk: Grow a module far past its starting size, open its settings dialogue, then zoom the canvas out; the module grew without a cap and keeps its size as the canvas zooms.
FL-111.observed: On the Stage, grew the imported module from 1150×692 to 2110×1412 (past its 24×20 default, no cap), opened its gear ('This module always shows all accessible data.', FL-111-gear.png), then zoomed the canvas to 70%: the module kept its size and scaled with the canvas (1477×988 on screen).

FL-112.walk: Add a tab, place the Injection module on it, and open the gear beside the title; the tab is a layer of the same stage and the gear holds the rarely changed options.
FL-112.observed: '+' (Create a layer) added 'Layer 2' as a tab beside Work/Graph/Injection/Layer 1 — another layer of the same Stage; the Injection Console was placed on it from the Library, and the gear beside its title holds the rarely changed options (Everything / Nearest source / Named stack). The gear popover is clipped at its right edge ('NEAREST S…'; the clipped gear popup is on M3EXF2's list, Codex 08).

FL-113.label: A finer, near-continuous background grid, more descriptive well-formatted hover tips, an easy way to create tabs, a much smaller archive button, a model device that is obviously clickable.
FL-113.walk: Hover a control on the stage; a well-formatted descriptive tip appears, the grid behind is near-continuous, a tab can be created easily, the archive button is small, and the model device looks clickable.
